dsh-plugins#dsh-appearance-gallery is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON, controlled custom skin-pack import via folder picker, preview, apply, delete and restore-default.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8884785b305864272fa1.html
